facts.fact: The Central Bank of Libya said on 31 July 2025 that it was sending public salaries to commercial bank accounts over the bank's own instant payment network.

LBY.note: No consumer rules or redress stated.

facts.fact: The Central Bank of Libya announced on 31 July 2025 its Ratibak Lahzi platform to transfer public-sector salaries into bank accounts, with bank links still being completed and national launch set for end of August.
The Central Bank of Libya said on 31 July 2025 that it developed and operates the Ratibak Lahzi public payroll platform in-house.

LBY.note: No survey share of adults with accounts stated.
No mobile money or wallet service stated; the instant network is described only for salary transfers.
No tax or fee payment stated.
